_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Keeps an unsent recording across reloads until the conversation accepts it. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Open the diffs" means: wait (up to 30s) for the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible, click the "Diffs" button in ".chat-workspace-actions" (if it is not visible, as on a phone, click the button "More options" instead and then the button whose name starts with "Diffs" in ".chat-overflow-popover"), and wait for the commit message. "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). "Remember where the content starts" means an eval with no expectation that sets window.__contentTop = document.querySelector(".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-content").getBoundingClientRect().y; "the content has not moved" means eval document.querySelector(".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-content").getBoundingClientRect().y === window.__contentTop is true. The server answers the recording's chat requests with 503 "unavailable" until call "accept chats". Call "requests" returns JSON counting the audio and review uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) and the accepted chat requests, and whether every accepted chat handed over a recording ("/transcription <path of a review-*.webm>"). Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/review and open the diffs.
2. Click the start button; the stop button should become visible. Wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button.
3. data-testid "review-recording-error" should contain "unavailable", and there should be exactly one data-testid "review-recording-pending". Call "requests" should return exactly {"uploads":2,"chats":0,"transcriptions":true}.
4. Navigate to /c/review again (a reload) and open the diffs. data-testid "review-recording-pending" should contain "Unsent recording".
5. A new recording leaves the unsent one in place, waiting its turn: call "accept chats", remember where the content starts, and click the start button. The status should be visible inside ".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-header", and the content has not moved. data-testid "review-recording-send" should be disabled.
6. Click the stop button. It is sent. There should still be exactly one review-recording-pending, and call "requests" should return exactly {"uploads":4,"chats":1,"transcriptions":true}.
7. Click data-testid "review-recording-send". review-recording-pending should be gone (count 0). Both files were already on the server, so only the handoff was retried: call "requests" should return exactly {"uploads":4,"chats":2,"transcriptions":true}.
8. Navigate to /c/review again (a reload) and open the diffs. There should be no data-testid "review-recording-bar" (count 0).
